evals.name: login-screen-greenfield
evals.prompt: I need to design a login screen in pencil. It should have email + password inputs, a primary submit button, and a 'forgot password?' link. Walk me through what you'd do step by step before touching any tools.
evals.expected_output: Agent describes the seven-step workflow: detects host first, locates context (open .pen, design-system/ folder, selection), loads guidelines, plans, executes via batch_design, verifies via get_screenshot, iterates. References design-system/ check and library import. Plans before executing.

evals.name: design-system-scaffold
evals.prompt: Set up a pencil design system in this project. The repo currently has no design-system/ folder.
evals.expected_output: Agent confirms before scaffolding; copies all 7 templates from assets/design-system/ to design-system/; names each file (README.md, design-system.md, tokens.md, components.md, layout.md, voice.md, code-export.md); mentions collision detection if a code-bearing design-system/ already exists; tells the user which fields to fill in first.

evals.name: import-library-and-use
evals.prompt: I have a design library at design/system.lib.pen with Button and Input components. Add a sign-up form to my open .pen file using those components. Explain the tools you'd call and why.
evals.expected_output: Agent verifies the document's imports field, adds an imports entry via U op on document root if missing, queries the library's reusable components, instantiates Button and Input via ref nodes (not from primitives), uses descendants for instance-level overrides, screenshots to verify the refs resolve correctly.
